title_en: Alumni · MD (2023–2026) · SJTU School of Medicine
title_cn: 校友 · 医学博士（2023–2026）· 上海交通大学医学院
bio_en: Former AI4Rad Lab member who completed MD doctoral training at SJTU School of Medicine from 2023 to 2026. Research focuses on clinical radiology and the application of large language models and deep learning to acute stroke imaging and clinical decision support.
bio_cn: AI4Rad Lab 毕业成员，2023–2026 年于上海交通大学医学院攻读医学博士。研究方向聚焦临床放射学，以及大语言模型与深度学习在急性卒中影像与临床决策支持中的应用。
interests_en: Large language models for acute stroke decision support
interests_cn: 临床放射学与神经放射学
